title: Security Deposit Payments and Full Security
content:
**Terms governing payment of a Security Deposit and the day it becomes fully secured.**

1. Deposit installments are paid directly to the Security Deposit and never through the service bill balance.
2. Deposit payments are accepted only while the deposit is in assessed status, as the deposit record shows it when the payment is made, for the deposit the payment is made to.
3. On the day the deposit becomes fully secured, the refund review date is set to the fully secured date plus the kind's review months, counted in calendar months.

## Clauses no longer in force

- The regular installment is the required amount divided by the installment count, rounded down to the cent, and the last installment carries the remainder. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)
- Each installment number is recorded once. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)
- The deposit becomes held on the day the cash received reaches the required amount, or on the day an accepted instrument for the full required amount is lodged: a surety bond, an irrevocable letter of credit or a third-party guarantee, each where the kind accepts it. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)

## Payment acceptance by status

| Deposit status | Deposit payment accepted? |
|---|---|
| Assessed | Yes |
| Held, waived, refunded, applied to final bill or cancelled | No |

## Review date examples (hypothetical dates)

| Fully secured date | Kind's review months | Refund review date |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 12 | 15 March of the following year |
| 15 March | 24 | 15 March two years later |
| 2 October | 36 | 2 October three years later |

**Is a deposit installment added to the customer's electric bill?** No. It is paid directly to the deposit and never through the service bill balance.

superseded_clauses: The regular installment is the required amount divided by the installment count, rounded down to the cent, and the last installment carries the remainder.
Each installment number is recorded once.

The deposit becomes held on the day deposit_msr_cash_received reaches the required amount, or on the day an accepted instrument for the full required amount is lodged: a surety bond where surety_bond_accepted is true, an irrevocable letter of credit where letter_of_credit_accepted is true, or a third-party guarantee where third_party_guarantee_accepted is true.
